d:
After years without elected student unions, Aligarh Muslim University (AMU) and Jamia Millia Islamia are witnessing a revival of student politics. From Jamia's 19-day agitation to AMU's return to elections after eight years, students have fought to reclaim their right to representation. But can this revival go beyond campus politics and pave the way for a new generation of Muslim political leadership?
Producer: Tista Roy Chowdhury
Edit: Prince Kesari
Camera: Madhur Shyam
